bundled_component.name: libdivsufsort 2.0.1
bundled_component.purpose: Suffix-array implementation used by BPS delta creation.

exclusion_reason: UR-Recomp uses only the CLI patch apply/create surface. GUI/platform integration and packaging assets are not execution dependencies.
dependency_closure: No package registry. The CLI builds from the system C++ compiler plus the libdivsufsort source already bundled in the pinned upstream tree.
build_contract: make TARGET=cli -jN; resulting ./flips --version and --help smoke successfully.
